items.question_text:
Our understanding of the store, as expressed in this interpreter,
      depends on the meaning of effects in Scheme. In particular, it depends on us knowing
      when these effects take place in a Scheme program. We can avoid this dependency by
      writing an interpreter that more closely mimics the specification. In this interpreter,
      value-of would return both a value and a store, just as in the specification. A fragment of this interpreter appears in figure 4.6. We call this a store-passing interpreter.
      Extend this interpreter to cover all of the language EXPLICIT-REFS.
      Every procedure that might modify the store returns not just its usual value but also a
      new store. These are packaged in a data type called answer. Complete this definition
      of value-of.
items.chinese_html:
本解释器对存储的理解依赖 Scheme 副作用的含义，特别是这些效果在 Scheme 程序中何时发生。可以写一个更贴近规格的解释器来避免这种依赖：让 value-of 像规格那样同时返回值和存储。图 4.6 给出这种“存储传递解释器”的片段。请把它扩充为覆盖整个 EXPLICIT-REFS 的解释器。任何可能修改存储的过程，都不仅返回通常的值，还返回新存储，两者用名为 answer 的数据类型打包。完成以下 value-of 定义。

下面保留原书图 4.6（p.116 / PDF 139）的接口与片段，含原有括号；解答另行解释需要修正的地方。

(define-datatype answer answer?
  (an-answer
    (val expval?)
    (store store?)))

value-of : Exp × Env × Sto → ExpVal
(define value-of
  (lambda (exp env store)
    (cases expression exp
      (const-exp (num)
        (an-answer (num-val num) store))
      (var-exp (var)
        (an-answer
          (apply-store store (apply-env env var))
          store))
      (if-exp (exp1 exp2 exp3)
        (cases answer (value-of exp1 env store)
          (an-answer (val new-store)
            (if (expval->bool val)
              (value-of exp2 env new-store)
              (value-of exp3 env new-store)))))
      (deref-exp (exp1)
        (cases answer (value-of exp1 env store)
          (an-answer (v1 new-store)
            (let ((ref1 (expval->ref v1)))
              (an-answer (deref ref1) new-store)))))
      ...)))

items.question_text:
Now that variables are mutable, we can build recursive procedures
by assignment. For example

        letrec times4(x) = if zero?(x)
                           then 0
                           else -((times4 -(x,1)), -4)
        in (times4 3)

can be replaced by

        let times4 = 0
        in begin
            set times4 = proc (x)
                          if zero?(x)
                          then 0
                          else -((times4 -(x,1)), -4);
            (times4 3)
           end

Trace this by hand and verify that this translation works.
items.chinese_html:
变量可变以后，可以用赋值构造递归过程。例如下面的 letrec 程序可替换成后面的程序。请手工跟踪并验证该翻译有效。

letrec times4(x) = if zero?(x)
                    then 0
                    else -((times4 -(x,1)), -4)
in (times4 3)
let times4 = 0
in begin
    set times4 = proc (x)
                  if zero?(x)
                  then 0
                  else -((times4 -(x,1)), -4);
    (times4 3)
   end

items.question_text:
In the language of this section, all variables are mutable, as they
are in Scheme. Another alternative is to allow both mutable and immutable variable
bindings:
                          ExpVal = Int + Bool + Proc
                          DenVal = Ref(ExpVal) + ExpVal
Variable assignment should work only when the variable to be assigned to has a
mutable binding. Dereferencing occurs implicitly when the denoted value is a reference.
Modify the language of this section so that let introduces immutable variables, as
before, but mutable variables are introduced by a letmutable expression, with syntax given by

        Expression ::= letmutable Identifier = Expression in Expression
items.chinese_html: 本节语言像 Scheme 一样，所有变量都可变。另一选择是同时允许可变与不可变绑定：ExpVal = Int + Bool + Proc，DenVal = Ref(ExpVal) + ExpVal。变量赋值只能用于可变绑定；当指称值是引用时，读取变量隐式解引用。修改语言，让 let 像以前一样引入不可变变量，而可变变量由以下文法引入：Expression ::= letmutable Identifier = Expression in Expression。

items.question_text:
We suggested earlier the use of assignment to make a program
      more modular by allowing one procedure to communicate information to a distant
      procedure without requiring intermediate procedures to be aware of it. Very often
      such an assignment should only be temporary, lasting for the execution of a procedure call. Add to the language a facility for dynamic assignment (also called fluid
      binding) to accomplish this. Use the production

           Expression ::= setdynamic Identifier = Expression during Expression
                          setdynamic-exp (var exp1 body)

      The effect of the setdynamic expression is to assign temporarily the value of exp1 to
      var, evaluate body, reassign var to its original value, and return the value of body. The
      variable var must already be bound. For example, in

              let x = 11
              in let p = proc (y) -(y,x)
                 in -(setdynamic x = 17 during (p 22),
                      (p 13))

      the value of x, which is free in procedure p, is 17 in the call (p 22), but is reset to 11
      in the call (p 13), so the value of the expression is 5 − 2 = 3.
items.chinese_html:
此前用赋值让一个过程向远处的过程传递信息，从而不要求中间过程了解该信息。很多时候这种赋值应是临时的，只持续一个过程调用。请增加“动态赋值”（dynamic assignment，又称 fluid binding）：Expression ::= setdynamic Identifier = Expression during Expression，抽象语法为 setdynamic-exp(var,exp1,body)。它把 exp1 的值暂时赋给已有绑定的 var，求 body，再恢复 var 原值，并返回 body 的值；var 必须已经绑定。例如下面 p 中的自由变量 x 在 (p 22) 时为 17，之后恢复为 11，整个式子应为 5-2=3。

let x = 11
in let p = proc (y) -(y,x)
   in -(setdynamic x = 17 during (p 22),
        (p 13))

items.question_text:
So far our languages have been expression-oriented: the primary
      syntactic category of interest has been expressions and we have primarily been interested in their values. Extend the language to model the simple statement-oriented
      language whose specification is sketched below. Be sure to Follow the Grammar by
      writing separate procedures to handle programs, statements, and expressions.

      Values As in IMPLICIT-REFS.
      Syntax Use the following syntax:

                          Program ::= Statement
                          Statement ::= Identifier = Expression
                                    ::= print Expression
                                    ::= {{Statement}∗(;) }
                                    ::= if Expression Statement Statement
                                    ::= while Expression Statement
                                    ::= var {Identifier}∗(,) ; Statement

         The nonterminal Expression refers to the language of expressions of IMPLICIT-
         REFS, perhaps with some extensions.
      Semantics A program is a statement. A statement does not return a value, but acts
        by modifying the store and by printing.
        Assignment statements work in the usual way. A print statement evaluates its
        actual parameter and prints the result. The if statement works in the usual way.
        A block statement, defined in the last production for Statement, binds each of the



   declared variables to an uninitialized reference and then executes the body of the
   block. The scope of these bindings is the body.
   Write the specification for statements using assertions like

                            (result-of stmt ρ σ0 ) = σ1

Examples Here are some examples.

      (run "var x,y; {x = 3; y = 4; print +(x,y)}") % Example 1
      7
      (run "var x,y,z; {x = 3;                      % Example 2
                        y = 4;
                        z = 0;
                        while not(zero?(x))
                          {z = +(z,y); x = -(x,1)};
                        print z}")
      12
      (run " var x; {x = 3;                         % Example 3
                     print x;
                     var x; {x = 4; print x};
                     print x}")
      3
      4
      3
      (run "var f,x; {f = proc(x,y) *(x,y);         % Example 4
                      x = 3;
                      print (f 4 x)}")
      12

   Example 3 illustrates the scoping of the block statement.

   Example 4 illustrates the interaction between statements and expressions. A procedure value is created and stored in the variable f. In the last line, this procedure
   is applied to the actual parameters 4 and x; since x is bound to a reference, it is
   dereferenced to obtain 3.
items.chinese_html:
此前语言以表达式为中心，主要关心其值。按以下规格扩充为简单的语句语言。请遵循文法，分别编写处理程序、语句和表达式的过程。

值域与 IMPLICIT-REFS 相同。语法如下；Expression 指 IMPLICIT-REFS 的表达式语言，可作适当扩充。花括号序列中的语句以分号分隔，var 后的标识符以逗号分隔。

Program   ::= Statement
Statement ::= Identifier = Expression
          ::= print Expression
          ::= { Statement* separated by ; }
          ::= if Expression Statement Statement
          ::= while Expression Statement
          ::= var Identifier* separated by , ; Statement

程序是语句。语句不返回值，通过修改存储与打印起作用。赋值、print 和 if 采用通常含义；print 求实参值并打印。最后一条产生式的块为所声明的每个变量绑定一个未初始化位置，再执行主体，作用域仅覆盖主体。用 result-of(stmt,ρ,σ0)=σ1 这样的断言给出语句规格。以下四例的预期输出分别为 7、12、三行 3/4/3、12。例 3 说明块作用域；例 4 中过程值存入 f，最后实参 x 先解引用为 3，再调用过程。

var x,y; {x = 3; y = 4; print +(x,y)}
var x,y,z; {x = 3;
            y = 4;
            z = 0;
            while not(zero?(x))
              {z = +(z,y); x = -(x,1)};
            print z}
var x; {x = 3;
        print x;
        var x; {x = 4; print x};
        print x}
var f,x; {f = proc(x,y) *(x,y);
          x = 3;
          print (f 4 x)}

items.question_text: Write down the specification rules for the five mutable-pair operations.
items.chinese_html: 写出可变序对五种操作 newpair、left、right、setleft、setright 的语义规格。每个序对有两个可独立赋值的位置。

items.question_text:
Add arrays to this language. Introduce new operators newarray,
      arrayref, and arrayset that create, dereference, and update arrays. This leads to

                               ArrVal = (Ref(ExpVal))∗
                               ExpVal = Int + Bool + Proc + ArrVal
                               DenVal = Ref(ExpVal)

      Since the locations in an array are consecutive, use a representation like the second
      representation above. What should be the result of the following program?




  let a = newarray(2,-99)
            p = proc (x)
                 let v = arrayref(x,1)
                 in arrayset(x,1,-(v,-1))
        in begin arrayset(a,1,0); (p a); (p a); arrayref(a,1) end

Here newarray(2,-99) is intended to build an array of size 2, with each location
in the array containing -99. begin expressions are defined in exercise 4.4. Make the
array indices zero-based, so an array of size 2 has indices 0 and 1.
items.chinese_html:
给语言增加数组，提供创建、读取和更新操作 newarray、arrayref、arrayset。值域为 ArrVal = (Ref(ExpVal))*，ExpVal = Int + Bool + Proc + ArrVal，DenVal = Ref(ExpVal)。数组的位置连续分配，采用类似本节第二种序对表示法的表示。下面程序应得到什么结果？newarray(2,-99) 创建长度 2、各元素初值为 −99 的数组。begin 如习题 4.4；下标从 0 开始，长度 2 的合法下标是 0、1。

let a = newarray(2,-99)
    p = proc (x)
         let v = arrayref(x,1)
         in arrayset(x,1,-(v,-1))
in begin arrayset(a,1,0); (p a); (p a); arrayref(a,1) end

items.question_text:
We can get some of the benefits of call-by-reference without leaving the call-by-value framework. Extend the language IMPLICIT-REFS by adding a
new expression
                          Expression ::= ref Identifier
                                         ref-exp (var)

This differs from the language EXPLICIT-REFS, since references are only of variables.
This allows us to write familiar programs such as swap within our call-by-value language. What should be the value of this expression?
        let a = 3
        in let b = 4
           in let swap = proc (x) proc (y)
                          let temp = deref(x)
                          in begin
                              setref(x,deref(y));
                              setref(y,temp)
                             end
              in begin ((swap ref a) ref b); -(a,b) end
Here we have used a version of let with multiple declarations (exercise 3.16). What
are the expressed and denoted values of this language?
items.chinese_html:
在按值框架中也能获得按引用传参的部分好处。为 IMPLICIT-REFS 增加 Expression ::= ref Identifier，抽象语法为 ref-exp(var)。它不同于 EXPLICIT-REFS：只能取得变量的引用。这样可在按值语言中写 swap。下面表达式应得什么值？题目说明采用多声明 let（习题 3.16）。这个语言的表达值与指称值分别是什么？

let a = 3
in let b = 4
   in let swap = proc (x) proc (y)
                  let temp = deref(x)
                  in begin
                      setref(x,deref(y));
                      setref(y,temp)
                     end
      in begin ((swap ref a) ref b); -(a,b) end

items.question_text:
Most languages support arrays, in which case array references are
generally treated like variable references under call-by-reference. If an operand is an
array reference, then the location referred to, rather than its contents, is passed to the
called procedure. This allows, for example, a swap procedure to be used in commonly
occurring situations in which the values in two array elements are to be exchanged.
Add array operators like those of exercise 4.29 to the call-by-reference language of this
section, and extend value-of-operand to handle this case, so that, for example, a
procedure application like

                 ((swap (arrayref a i)) (arrayref a j))

will work as expected. What should happen in the case of

       ((swap (arrayref a (arrayref a i))) (arrayref a j)) ?
items.chinese_html:
大多数语言支持数组，按引用传参时通常把数组元素引用当作变量引用：若实参是数组元素访问，传入的是该元素位置而非内容。这样 swap 可交换数组两项。请把类似习题 4.29 的数组操作加入 CALL-BY-REFERENCE，并扩充 value-of-operand，使下面调用按预期工作；第二种嵌套数组下标情况应如何处理？

((swap (arrayref a i)) (arrayref a j))
((swap (arrayref a (arrayref a i))) (arrayref a j))

items.question_text:
Call-by-value-result is a variation on call-by-reference. In call-by-value-result, the actual parameter must be a variable. When a parameter is passed,
the formal parameter is bound to a new reference initialized to the value of the actual



              parameter, just as in call-by-value. The procedure body is then executed normally.
              When the procedure body returns, however, the value in the new reference is copied
              back into the reference denoted by the actual parameter. This may be more efficient
              than call-by-reference because it can improve memory locality. Implement call-by-value-result and write a program that produces different answers using call-by-valueresult and call-by-reference.
items.chinese_html: 按值结果传参（call-by-value-result）是按引用传参的一种变体：实参必须是变量。调用时像按值传参一样，给形参绑定一个新引用，初值是实参当前的值，正常执行过程体；但在过程返回时，把该新位置中的值复制回实参变量的位置。这样可能改善内存局部性，从而比按引用更有效率。实现这种策略，并写一个在值结果与按引用下得到不同答案的程序。

下例是习题 3.25 的一个变体，它在按需求值下可以工作。原习题 3.25 的程序在按需求值下能否工作？若把下例放在按值解释器中运行会怎样，为什么？

let makerec = proc (f)
               let d = proc (x) (f (x x))
               in (f (d d))
in let maketimes4 = proc (f)
                     proc (x)
                       if zero?(x)
                       then 0
                       else -((f -(x,1)), -4)
   in let times4 = (makerec maketimes4)
      in (times4 3)

items.question_text:
In the absence of effects, call-by-name and call-by-need always give
      the same answer. Construct an example in which call-by-name and call-by-need give
      different answers.
items.chinese_html: 没有副作用时，按名与按需总给出相同答案。构造一个有副作用的例子，使两者得到不同答案。
